title: Successful Appeals for Earlier Withdrawal of CPF Payouts
what_it_is: Successful Appeals for Earlier Withdrawal of CPF Payouts

sections.label: Medical Grounds Scheme applications
sections.summary: About 65% of Medical Grounds Scheme applications were successful in the past three years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In the past three years, about 65% of applications under the Medical Grounds Scheme were successful.

sections.label: Employment rate older residents
sections.summary: The employment rate for residents aged 60 to 64 rose from 47.2% in 2008 to 60.4% in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In the last decade, the employment rate for residents aged between 60 and 64 has risen from 47.2% in 2008 to 60.4% in 2018.

sections.label: Re-employment, older workers, CPF payout age
sections.summary: Over 98% of eligible re-employment seekers were offered re-employment, a Tripartite Workgroup on Older Workers was formed in 2018, and MOM has no plans to lower the CPF Payout Eligibility Age.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Of those eligible for re-employment and who wished to continue working, over 98% were offered re-employment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In 2018, a Tripartite Workgroup on Older Workers was formed to review, among other things, the longer-term relevance of and the next moves on the retirement and re-employment ages.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: However, as the CPF Payout Eligibility Age was raised to 65 only in 2018, the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) does not have plans to lower it.

sections.label: Payout eligibility age international standards
sections.summary: By international standards, setting the payout eligibility age at 65 is not unusual.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: By international standards, setting the payout eligibility age at 65 is not unusual at all.

sections.label: Netherlands pension withdrawal age
sections.summary: In the Netherlands, the pension withdrawal age will rise from 66 to 67 in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In the case of the Netherlands, for example, the pension withdrawal age will go up from 66 to 67 in the year 2021.

sections.label: Tripartite consensus priority
sections.summary: The main priority now is building a tripartite consensus on the way forward, which is the topmost priority this year.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The main priority for now is to build a tripartite consensus on the way forward.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The new tripartite consensus is an important one and it is the topmost of my priority this year.
